# PrimeBlocks

The ultimate collection of UI blocks crafted with Tailwind CSS to build spectacular applications in no time.

PrimeBlocks is a separate **commercial product** by PrimeTek — a collection of 400+ ready-to-use UI blocks crafted with Tailwind CSS for building application UIs quickly with PrimeNG. It is not part of the primeng.org documentation; the sidebar entry opens https://primeblocks.org in a new tab. Its landing page is a client-rendered SPA, so no further structured documentation is scrapable from here.
